recommendations.overall_recommendation_summary: To improve your CV and job matching for the position at Typhoon HIL, focus on enhancing the clarity and organization of your skills, adding measurable outcomes to your projects, and addressing the significant gaps in required skills such as embedded systems and Linux operating systems.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Add Measurable Outcomes to Projects
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Including measurable results or outcomes for each project will demonstrate the impact of your work and enhance the overall quality of your CV.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV currently lacks measurable results or achievements in projects, which is a noted weakness.

recommended_actions.action_description: For each project, add specific outcomes or results achieved, such as performance improvements, user feedback, or successful implementation metrics.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will strengthen your CV by showcasing the effectiveness of your contributions and improving your match for roles requiring demonstrated impact.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Organize Skills Section
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: A well-organized skills section will improve readability and help highlight your relevant skills more effectively.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The skills section is currently not well organized, making it harder to read, which is a noted weakness.

recommended_actions.action_description: Organize your skills into categories such as Programming Languages, Tools, and Concepts to enhance clarity.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will make it easier for recruiters to quickly identify your relevant skills, improving your CV's effectiveness.

missing_required_skills_recommendations.evidence: The job requires a strong background in embedded systems, which is not mentioned in your CV.

recommended_actions.action_description: Consider taking online courses or working on projects that involve embedded systems to build your knowledge and experience in this area.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will help you meet the job requirements and improve your overall job fit for similar positions.

missing_required_skills_recommendations.evidence: Knowledge of Linux operating systems is a critical requirement for the job, but there is no evidence of this in your CV.

recommended_actions.action_description: If you have experience with Linux, add it to your CV. Otherwise, consider learning Linux through online resources or courses.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will address a significant gap in your profile and enhance your suitability for the role.

recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will help you understand the requirements of the role better and prepare you for future opportunities.
